_doc: Hero core melee (H5 #301). Tier A: WZ levels, boxes, hit counts, art and sounds. Tier C: cooldowns, auto-targeting and rarity bonuses; see GAME_DESIGN 7.33.

power_strike._h11: tier C #346: first-pass melee cooldown/Combo tuning, GAME_DESIGN 4.1/4.2; WZ values unchanged.
power_strike.name: Power Strike
power_strike.desc: Deals a killer blow to the nearest monster within your weapon's reach.

text.desc: Deliver a killer blow to a monster within your weapon's reach.

power_strike._survivor: Tier A: unchanged WZ fields and visuals. Tier C: eight survivor ranks, cooldown/targeting and rarity bonuses (GAME_DESIGN 7.33); no weapon gate.

slash_blast._h11: tier C #346: first-pass melee cooldown/Combo tuning, GAME_DESIGN 4.1/4.2; WZ values unchanged.
slash_blast.name: Slash Blast
slash_blast.desc: Spends HP to strike every monster around you.

text.desc: Use HP to attack the monsters around you.
text.h: HP -{hp_cost}; damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters} within {range} px

brandish.name: Brandish
brandish.desc: Strike monsters in front of you twice.

text.desc: Strike monsters in front of you twice.

brandish._survivor: Tier A: box, attackCount, mobCount, action aliases and their 840 ms total delay. Tier C: 1.4 s cooldown, forward admission, one body action/effect per cast chosen by handedness (orchestrator ruling #301), rarity bonuses.

shout._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #303 bonuses named after the lineage (spec #296): Rare area x1.2, Epic Booster cooldown x0.88, Unique Echo Shout cooldown x0.75, Legendary Echo Shout plus area x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.33.
shout._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1111008 damage 14 to 30 %, mobCount 6, the centred box (-110..-200, -82..-150) to (110..200, 83..150), prop (stun chance 52 to 95 %), time (stun seconds 5 to 10), the alert3 action, effect and hit art, the Use sound and the stun stars (`mob`). Tier C: the explicit `ranks` table (D4): level 4 stores its prop under the stray key "58" (String.wz agrees with 58 %, so the key is a corrupted `prop`), so rank 1 reads level 5 (60 %) instead; the 12 s cooldown, the three-mob admission gate and the 0.6 s action hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.33.
shout._h11: tier C #346: first-pass melee cooldown/Combo tuning, GAME_DESIGN 4.1/4.2; WZ values unchanged.
shout.name: Shout
shout.desc: Roars at the monsters around you, hurting and stunning them.

text.desc: Roar at the crowd around you to damage and stun up to 6 monsters. Needs 3 monsters in the roar's box.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to stun for {time} sec.

monster_magnet._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #303 bonuses (spec #296): Rare reach x1.2 (the `range` modifier: a range_around cast reads `range`, never `area`), Epic Bigger Grab +2 targets, Unique Booster cooldown x0.75, Legendary Booster plus +2 targets (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.33.
monster_magnet._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1121001 range 200 to 400 px, prop (pull chance 48 to 95 %), mobCount 6, the 18-frame effect and the Use sound. Tier C: no damage (the node has none); pulling is the shared `pull` block (7.35); the alert2 action (the node names none; its `prepare` dash makes a two-handed axe vanish, H1 #297), the 10 s cooldown, the three-mob admission gate (`cast.min_targets`, any mob in range counts, pulled or not) and the 0.6 s action hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.33.
monster_magnet._h11: tier C #346: first-pass melee cooldown/Combo tuning, GAME_DESIGN 4.1/4.2; WZ values unchanged.
monster_magnet.name: Monster Magnet
monster_magnet.desc: Drags the monsters around you toward you.

text.desc: Drag distant monsters toward you, into reach of your other skills. Needs 3 monsters in range.

rush_hero.name: Rush
rush_hero.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and shoving every monster in your path. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Rush key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and knocking back the monsters in your path. Hold the key to keep charging.

rush_hero._rush: Tier A: WZ 1121006 at rank 1 = WZ level 4 (the survivor rank table for a level-30 skill, ceil(1 x 30 / 8); the shared balance.mobility_rank_levels rule raises it with the round level to rank 8 = level 30, 130%, 250 px): damage 78%, mobCount 15, box lt (-170,-50) rb (0,0), whose reach is also the dash distance (field lt.x), action rush2 (stabOF), effect/1..6 and effect0 dust, the Use sound. Tier C: the 2.0 s cooldown (the balance lever), always-on 80 px knockback in the dash direction (bosses resist, no chance field, no RNG draw), hold-to-repeat, no start while climbing, no orb gain or bonus, the bot dashes away from a mob within 60 px, at most every 3 s (BotInput.RUSH_MIN_INTERVAL).

panic._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #304 bonuses named after the lineage (spec #296): Rare Sword Mastery damage x1.2, Epic Booster cooldown x0.88 (the 2 s base keeps it above the 1 s meter floor, so it shows), Unique Advanced Combo keeps 2 orbs, Legendary Advanced Combo plus damage x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.33.
panic._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1111003 damage 150 to 350 %, prop (38 to 90 %), time (5 to 9 s), the finish/1..10 and hit/0|1 art, the Use sound, req Combo Attack; the axe twin 1111004 has identical nodes. Tier C: the nearest-target auto-cast within 250 px with scheduled bosses first, a 2.0 s cooldown (the 1.0 s meter floor would hide a Booster), the Threaten cut of min(level, 20) on the threatened status, finish art keyed by orbs spent (tier B reading), first swing stance of the held weapon. Bosses take the damage but never the status. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.33.
panic._h11: tier C #346: first-pass melee cooldown/Combo tuning, GAME_DESIGN 4.1/4.2; WZ values unchanged.
panic.name: Panic : Sword
panic.desc: Smashes one monster with every Combo orb, weakening it.

text.desc: Spend all Combo orbs on one monster within 250 px; a boss comes first. The more orbs, the harder the blow. Weakens the target's attack and defence.
text.h: Damage {damage}%; {prop}% chance to weaken for {time} sec.

coma._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #304 bonuses named after the lineage (spec #296): Rare Sword Mastery damage x1.2, Epic Wide Reach area x1.2 (range_around scales its radius by area), Unique Advanced Combo keeps 2 orbs, Legendary Advanced Combo plus damage x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.33.
coma._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1111005 damage 84 to 200 % (rank 1 = level 4: 96 %), range 130 to 150, mobCount 6, hpCon 15 to 25, prop (38 to 90 %), time (2 to 4 s), the finish/1..10, hit/0|1 and mob (stun stars) art, the Use sound, req Combo Attack; the axe twin 1111006 has identical nodes. Tier C: the around-the-body auto-cast at three or more mobs in range, a 1.0 s cooldown (the meter floor), finish art keyed by orbs spent (tier B reading), first swing stance of the held weapon. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.33.
coma._h11: tier C #346: first-pass melee cooldown/Combo tuning, GAME_DESIGN 4.1/4.2; WZ values unchanged.
coma.name: Coma : Sword
coma.desc: Slams the monsters around you with every Combo orb, stunning them.

text.desc: Spend all Combo orbs on the crowd around you (needs 3 monsters in range). The more orbs, the harder the blow. Costs HP, never the last point.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to stun for {time} sec.
